verses.en: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
verses.pt: Tudo tem a sua ocasião própria, e há tempo para todo propósito debaixo do céu.
verses.en_web: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
verses.en_bbe: For everything there is a fixed time, and a time for every business under the sun.

verses.en: A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
verses.pt: Há tempo de nascer, e tempo de morrer; tempo de plantar, e tempo de arrancar o que se plantou;
verses.en_web: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
verses.en_bbe: A time for birth and a time for death; a time for planting and a time for uprooting;

verses.en: A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;
verses.pt: tempo de matar, e tempo de curar; tempo de derribar, e tempo de edificar;
verses.en_web: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;
verses.en_bbe: A time to put to death and a time to make well; a time for pulling down and a time for building up;

verses.en: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
verses.pt: tempo de chorar, e tempo de rir; tempo de prantear, e tempo de dançar;
verses.en_web: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
verses.en_bbe: A time for weeping and a time for laughing; a time for sorrow and a time for dancing;

verses.en: A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
verses.pt: tempo de espalhar pedras, e tempo de ajuntar pedras; tempo de abraçar, e tempo de abster-se de abraçar;
verses.en_web: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
verses.en_bbe: A time to take stones away and a time to get stones together; a time for kissing and a time to keep from kissing;

verses.en: A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;
verses.pt: tempo de buscar, e tempo de perder; tempo de guardar, e tempo de deitar fora;
verses.en_web: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;
verses.en_bbe: A time for search and a time for loss; a time to keep and a time to give away;

verses.en: A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
verses.pt: tempo de rasgar, e tempo de coser; tempo de estar calado, e tempo de falar;
verses.en_web: a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
verses.en_bbe: A time for undoing and a time for stitching; a time for keeping quiet and a time for talk;

verses.en: A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.
verses.pt: tempo de amar, e tempo de odiar; tempo de guerra, e tempo de paz.
verses.en_web: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.
verses.en_bbe: A time for love and a time for hate; a time for war and a time for peace.

verses.en: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?
verses.pt: Que proveito tem o trabalhador naquilo em que trabalha?
verses.en_web: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?
verses.en_bbe: What profit has the worker in the work which he does?

verses.en: I have seen the travail, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.
verses.pt: Tenho visto o trabalho penoso que Deus deu aos filhos dos homens para nele se exercitarem.
verses.en_web: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.
verses.en_bbe: I saw the work which God has put on the sons of man.

verses.en: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.
verses.pt: Tudo fez formoso em seu tempo; também pôs na mente do homem a idéia da eternidade, se bem que este não possa descobrir a obra que Deus fez desde o princípio até o fim.
verses.en_web: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.
verses.en_bbe: He has made everything right in its time; but he has made their hearts without knowledge, so that man is unable to see the works of God, from the first to the last.

verses.en: I know that there is no good in them, but for a man to rejoice, and to do good in his life.
verses.pt: Sei que não há coisa melhor para eles do que se regozijarem e fazerem o bem enquanto viverem;
verses.en_web: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.
verses.en_bbe: I am certain that there is nothing better for a man than to be glad, and to do good while life is in him.

verses.en: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God.
verses.pt: e também que todo homem coma e beba, e goze do bem de todo o seu trabalho é dom de Deus.
verses.en_web: Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.
verses.en_bbe: And for every man to take food and drink, and have joy in all his work, is a reward from God.

verses.en: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth it, that men should fear before him.
verses.pt: Eu sei que tudo quanto Deus faz durará eternamente; nada se lhe pode acrescentar, e nada se lhe pode tirar; e isso Deus faz para que os homens temam diante dele:
verses.en_web: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.
verses.en_bbe: I am certain that whatever God does will be for ever. No addition may be made to it, nothing may be taken from it; and God has done it so that man may be in fear before him.

verses.en: That which hath been is now; and that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past.
verses.pt: O que é, já existiu; e o que há de ser, também já existiu; e Deus procura de novo o que ja se passou.
verses.en_web: That which is has been long ago, and that which is to be has been long ago: and God seeks again that which is passed away.
verses.en_bbe: Whatever is has been before, and what is to be is now; because God makes search for the things which are past.

verses.en: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, that wickedness was there; and the place of righteousness, that iniquity was there.
verses.pt: Vi ainda debaixo do sol que no lugar da retidão estava a impiedade; e que no lugar da justiça estava a impiedade ainda.
verses.en_web: Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.
verses.en_bbe: And again, I saw under the sun, in the place of the judges, that evil was there; and in the place of righteousness, that evil was there.

verses.en: I said in mine heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked: for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.
verses.pt: Eu disse no meu coração: Deus julgará o justo e o ímpio; porque há um tempo para todo propósito e para toda obra.
verses.en_web: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.”
verses.en_bbe: I said in my heart, God will be judge of the good and of the bad; because a time for every purpose and for every work has been fixed by him.

verses.en: I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.
verses.pt: Disse eu no meu coração: Isso é por causa dos filhos dos homens, para que Deus possa prová-los, e eles possam ver que são em si mesmos como os brutos.
verses.en_web: I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.
verses.en_bbe: I said in my heart, It is because of the sons of men, so that God may put them to the test and that they may see themselves as beasts.

verses.en: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all is vanity.
verses.pt: Pois o que sucede aos filhos dos homens, isso mesmo também sucede aos brutos; uma e a mesma coisa lhes sucede; como morre um, assim morre o outro; todos têm o mesmo fôlego; e o homem não tem vantagem sobre os brutos; porque tudo é vaidade.
verses.en_web: For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one breath; and man has no advantage over the animals: for all is vanity.
verses.en_bbe: Because the fate of the sons of men and the fate of the beasts is the same. As is the death of one so is the death of the other, and all have one spirit. Man is not higher than the beasts; because all is to no purpose.

verses.en: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.
verses.pt: Todos vão para um lugar; todos são pó, e todos ao pó tornarão.
verses.en_web: All go to one place. All are from the dust, and all turn to dust again.
verses.en_bbe: All go to one place, all are of the dust, and all will be turned to dust again.

verses.en: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth?
verses.pt: Quem sabe se o espírito dos filhos dos homens vai para cima, e se o espírito dos brutos desce para a terra?
verses.en_web: Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”
verses.en_bbe: Who is certain that the spirit of the sons of men goes up to heaven, or that the spirit of the beasts goes down to the earth?

verses.en: Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?
verses.pt: Pelo que tenho visto que não há coisa melhor do que alegrar-se o homem nas suas obras; porque esse é o seu quinhão; pois quem o fará voltar para ver o que será depois dele?
verses.en_web: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his works; for that is his portion: for who can bring him to see what will be after him?
verses.en_bbe: So I saw that there is nothing better than for a man to have joy in his work--because that is his reward. Who will make him see what will come after him?
